story.title: Elon Musk's lawsuit puts OpenAI's safety record on trial as for-profit conversion faces scrutiny
story.summary: As the Musk v. Altman trial progresses, legal proceedings are surfacing detailed examination of OpenAI's internal safety decisions and whether its shift to a for-profit structure compromises its founding public-benefit mission. Musk's legal team is arguing that OpenAI's commercial priorities have increasingly overridden its stated commitment to ensuring AI benefits humanity broadly. The trial is producing a rare public record of how one of the world's most influential AI labs weighs safety against commercial incentives.
